QuestInfo.0: What the heck was #p1061011# freaking out about?
QuestInfo.1: If you want to see what sort of underworld nightmare is hanging out on you, you'll need a #t4033126#.\n\n#i4033126# #t4033126# #b#c4033126# / 50#k

0.0: What kind of ju-ju did you get yourself into, traveler? You carry a terrifying burden on your back, though I'm sure your mind's eye cannot see it.
0.1: I can't let you go running around like that in good conscience. I'll make you a #bcharm#k to weaken that thing, but you're going to have to talk to it and make it go away.

yes.0: If you leave that thing alone, it's bound to start causing you problems. I'll need #b50 #t4033126##k bottles to create a strong enough charm to weaken it.

no.0: You must have your reasons for wanting to be possessed by a demon...

1.0: I am glad you returned. I wish that thing on your back was not smiling at me. Please allow me to make the charm before it steals your soul.

item.0: I admire your foolish bravery, but I would really recommend bringing me the #b50#k #b#t4033126##k bottles I need. I hope, for your sake, that you are strong enough to defeat the #r#o7130100##k beasts.
